# Made-up MCP
<!-- RELEASE 1.2.4: when dataarcus-1.2.4.mcpb is released, change 1.2.3 to 1.2.4 in step 2 (three places). -->
2. **Get the extension:** download the latest `.mcpb` file (for 1.2.3, `dataarcus-1.2.3.mcpb`) from
   https://github.com/Antnioo/dataarcus-releases/releases and run
   `certutil -hashfile "dataarcus-1.2.3.mcpb" SHA256` (or in PowerShell, `Get-FileHash "dataarcus-1.2.3.mcpb"`).
The plugin becomes its own repository after the 1.2.4 release.
